description: A full text dashboard: word/char counts, reading & speaking time, avg word length and a top-10 word frequency table.

faqs.a: Reading time assumes 200 words per minute; speaking time assumes 130 words per minute.
faqs.q: How are reading and speaking times calculated?

faqs.a: The table lists the 10 most common words with counts and percentages, ignoring case.
faqs.q: What is in the frequency table?

faqs.a: No — every stat is computed locally in your browser; nothing leaves your device.

howto: Review counts, times and the top-10 words.
title: Text Statistics Dashboard
